Implementation complete; gates green. Two plan defects found during implementation, plus one measured deviation.

**Plan defect 1 — the 20 originals use three status-line formats, not one.** The plan's edit instruction assumed a bare `**Status:**` line in every file. Actual distribution:
- bare `**Status:** X` — 9 files (0031, 0055, 0084, 0085, 0092, 0094, 0096, 0097, 0099)
- list item `- **Status:** X` — 10 files (0004, 0026, 0027, 0028, 0029, 0060, 0062, 0083, 0103, 0107)
- unbolded `Status: X` — 1 file (0095)

A single bare-pattern edit would have silently skipped 11 of 20 and failed AC2. Each file keeps its own format; the archived text was inserted in place.

**Plan defect 2 — two status values wrap onto continuation lines.** 0103's status spans 4 lines and 0107's spans 5. A first pass that captured only the first line left truncated text and an unbalanced parenthesis in both files. Corrected: the continuation is folded into the preserved `(was: …)` parenthetical, so no original status text is lost.

Banner placement: immediately after the title, below any pre-existing blockquote (0026's number note, 0029's context-landed note, 0083's renumbering note, 0095's partial-supersession note stay first). For 0095 this is above `## Decision`, as the plan requires.

**Deviation — 0121 is 896 lines against the plan's 400–600 target.** The originals total 3,379 lines, so this is a 73% reduction. Reaching 600 would require deleting decision content, which contradicts the plan's own "one section per surviving decision" rule. Two trim passes removed the inline rejected-alternative passages that Appendix A already collects, and compressed §§9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 17, 18, 20. No AC constrains length; the 400–600 figure was an estimate made before the 20 ADRs were read.

Verification on this tree:
- AC1: 20 `### N. … — from ADR 00xx` headings, 20 distinct ADR numbers, 3 supersedes notes (0031 §"Band-aid retirement", 0083 §(g), 0092 §Decision ¶2). PASS
- AC2: 20 of 20 originals carry `Archived — consolidated into [ADR 0121]`; `git diff -U0 -- docs/adr/ | grep '^[-+]#'` is empty, so no pre-existing heading changed. PASS
- AC3: `docs/adr/.numbers/0121` = `0121-reconciler-architecture-consolidated-record.md`; `check_adr_numbers.py`, `gen_adr_index.py --check`, `check_docs_index.py --check`, `check_criteria_vocabulary.py`, `check_dco_identity.py` all exit 0. 0121 indexed under "Reconciler & Jira sync". PASS

## Context / Problem
Twenty ADRs describe one subsystem (titles confirmed by `git ls-tree origin/main -- docs/adr`): 0004 snapshot contract, 0026 three-way-merge baseline, 0027 binding lifecycle, 0028 bound-but-absent, 0029 status/echo, 0031 ref-lock, 0055 Jira-family sub-seam, 0060 bridge-state formats, 0062 pagination stall, 0083 vendor-adapter seam, 0084 ACLI 429 backoff, 0085 live-validation harness, 0092 bridge vocabulary, 0094 last-pass two-witness, 0095 DC wiki renderer, 0096 Pandoc corpus, 0097 many-to-many projects, 0099 binding-store ownership, 0103 operation coordination, 0107 typed mutation payload. Overrides among them: 0055 AMENDS 0083 (`0055-…md:5`). Numbering hazard for the consolidation: 0055's own text at `:9` phrases that narrowing as "one claim 0035 made", and its caution note at `:13-15` records that a bare "ADR 0035" is ambiguous in this repo. The authoritative statement is in the target ADR itself — `0083-…md:11` says 0055 "**narrows** this ADR's proof-of-seam claim" — so section 15 below resolves to 0083, not to the unrelated `0035-rc2b-snapshot-horizon-safe-replay.md`. Resolve every ADR reference in 0121 to a filename, never to a bare number; 0092's adapters paragraph is overridden by its S2 amendment; 0031's C2/C3/C4 sections and 0107 §4/§Open items are landed transitions (epics `6c9c-811f-6dc4-40e7`, story `e9d5-c850-d505-4a5a` closed); 0027's amendment fixes the `rebar bridge fsck` spelling. Everything else is additive (0103 retains 0084 jitter `:44-46`; 0107 §5 leaves 0004/0026/0027/0028/0029/0083/0092 unaffected).

## Approach
Write `docs/adr/0121-reconciler-architecture-consolidated-record.md` — **final-form decision statements, not verbatim copies** (target 400–600 lines; originals remain the verbatim evidence). Header: `**Status:** Accepted — consolidates ADRs 0004, 0026, 0027, 0028, 0029, 0031, 0055, 0060, 0062, 0083, 0084, 0085, 0092, 0094, 0095, 0096, 0097, 0099, 0103, 0107.` Rule stated up front: one section per surviving decision, the originating ADR in the heading; where a later ADR overrode an earlier one the decision appears once in final form with a "supersedes ADR 00xx §y" note. Section outline (headings verbatim, `### N. Title — from ADR 00xx`):

- Part A Data contracts: 1. Producer↔consumer snapshot contract and the rules for new reconciler tests — 0004; 2. Typed mutation payload, a discriminated union by (direction, action), and its ownership table — 0107 (§4 sequencing and §Open items recorded as landed history); 3. Bridge state stays committed, formats cheap (A1, A2, A3, A4-2) — 0060; 4. The project set belongs to the store; legacy migration writes no ticket events; capability stamped conditionally — 0097.
- Part B Arbitration: 5. Three-way-merge baseline and direction arbitration — 0026; 6. Canonical reverse status map, provenance+single-pass echo suppression, exact-match assignee — 0029; 7. Bound-but-absent ≠ deleted: deletion proven only by bounded direct GET 404 — 0028.
- Part C Bindings: 8. Binding lifecycle pending→confirmed→retired, adoption gating, audit vocabulary `rebar bridge fsck` — 0027 (+amendment); 9. Binding-store internal ownership behind one facade (open views, shallow `all_bindings()`, three failure dispositions, ordered partial states, repair-before-first-observation, explicit `unretire`, persistence ≠ publication) — 0099.
- Part D Coordination: 10. Bare-ref CAS pass-lock/phase-gate, lease self-healing, ref backend only — 0031 (supersedes 0031 §"Band-aid retirement" transitional text; break-glass commands → runbook pointer, see S4); 11. Last-pass two-witness status — 0094; 12. Single retry budget + observe-before-replay, eleven-disposition taxonomy, fuse — 0103 (§"S1 lifecycle boundary" recorded as landed); 13. ACLI subprocess 429 backoff, retained beneath 0103 — 0084; 14. A stalled pager aborts past fail-open handlers — 0062.
- Part E Vendor seam and Jira family: 15. Jira-neutral core + `adapters/<backend>/`, Phase 2 landed, proof-of-seam claim as narrowed — 0083 (supersedes 0083 §(g)/proof-of-seam per 0055); 16. Jira-family sub-seam, shared `jira` provenance, DC horizon 2029-03-28 — 0055; 17. DC Markdown→wiki segmenting, verify-then-fall-back renderer, pins 3.9/1.17 — 0095; 18. Complete Pandoc corpus replay in external integration — 0096.
- Part F Operator surface: 19. Bridge-primary vocabulary; adapters removed, `--filter-local-ids` engine-only survives — 0092 (supersedes 0092 §Decision ¶2); 20. Live-validation harness: deterministic core + live probes under bilateral teardown — 0085 (§4 report → runbook pointer, S4).
- Appendix A Rejected alternatives (collected from 0055 (i), 0060, 0062, 0094, 0095, 0096, 0099 §9). Appendix B Provenance table ADR → section(s).

Then in each of the 20 originals change the status to `**Status:** Archived — consolidated into [ADR 0121](0121-reconciler-architecture-consolidated-record.md)` (keep the original status text in parentheses after it, e.g. `(was: Accepted (epic adept-hedge-stain / d01e))`) and add the banner `> **Archived (2026-09-07).** Consolidated into [ADR 0121](…) §N; kept verbatim as the evidence record.` Bodies untouched. Exactly **one** ADR body is pinned by a test: `tests/unit/reconciler/test_wiki_render.py::test_adr_0095_records_the_required_sections` reads `docs/adr/0095-dc-segmenting-wiki-renderer.md` at `:338` and asserts its six headings (`## Decision`, `## Invariants`, `## Pin provenance`, `## Alternatives`, `## Platform`, `## Deferrals`), the strings "3.9" and "1.17", and that `docs/adr/.numbers/0095` names the file. CORRECTED: this plan previously also claimed a range in `test_apply_handlers_operation_outcome.py` pinned 0103 on "s3", "cutover", "fuse" and "retire". It does not — that file is **53 lines long**, so the cited range lay past its end, and its only mention of the ADR is prose in the module docstring at `:4`. No assertion anywhere constrains 0103's body. The status-line and banner edits are safe for all 20 either way, since neither touches a body; the one genuine pin is called out so the 0095 edit stays above its `## Decision` heading. Run `python scripts/gen_adr_index.py` (adds `docs/adr/.numbers/0121` and the index row under "Reconciler & Jira sync"). Do not write "success criteria"/"SC" in 0121 (`scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py`, no ADR is allowlisted) and no bot e-mail (`check_dco_identity.py`).
